capability.summary: Retrieve one Hacker News item by id
capability.description: Fetches the Firebase Hacker News item endpoint for one required numeric item id. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Individual Hacker News story/comment/poll/job reference; not top-story listing, search, moderation, or news summarization.

constraint.io_signature: Input: id at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Hacker News item result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one Hacker News item id string or integer
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: no topstories, newstories, search, child expansion, pagination, or comment-tree input
wrapper does not locally truncate or parse the item
deleted/dead/missing items are represented by the API response; no auth, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing one Hacker News item, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: look up a Hacker News story
retrieve a Hacker News comment or item by id
negative_intents: search or summarize arbitrary news sources
